messages:
support-alice: SLO alert - p95 latency + 5xx fraction spike for hosted-infer in us-west1 starting ~2026-03-17T15:02Z. Customers reporting timeouts (504s). Anyone oncall? https://console.redwood/status/alerts/7605001234 :rotating_light:

sre-bot: Alert: hosted-infer.us-west1.p95_latency > 1.2s AND 5xx_fraction > 0.03 (runbook: /runbooks/hosted-infer-5xx)

maria: I'm on. pulling up dashboards now. Do we have traces for the window 15:02-15:12?

ashok: Not seeing many spans for that window in jaeger. trace coverage drop around same time; could be tracing sampling or sidecar crash.

jules: Trying logs query for ingress gateway around 15:00-15:10:
```
resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.cluster_name="hosted-infer-usw1"
jsonPayload.service="gateway" AND timestamp>="2026-03-17T15:00:00Z" AND timestamp<="2026-03-17T15:12:00Z"
| jsonPayload.status_code, jsonPayload.upstream, jsonPayload.latency
| top 50 by count(status_code)
```

maria: query shows bunch of 504s with upstream "ml-proxy" and latencies ~10s before timeout.

support-alice: sample user repro curl that returned 504:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <tok>" "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate" -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"hi"}'
# response: HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout, Content-Length: 0
```

ashok: Also noticed a burst of auth-service 401->retry loops at 15:01-15:05 in auth logs. Token refreshes spiking. Could be authz backlog causing request queueing at gateway.

jules: correlation note: kvcache RTT spiked at same time (see metric kvcache.request_latency.p99). Prefetch was enabled for these routes; might be kv cache thrash.

maria: Traces missing because gateway never sent requests to upstream (no upstream span). That matches ml-proxy handshake failing.

ashok: Quick repro: hit internal /health of ml-proxy from gateway pod, got connection reset 5/6 times. Sharing tcpdump snippet in thread.

support-alice: Customer impact: ~12 customers experienced OOS errors during spike. Escalation to support lead done.

jules: Actionable next steps:
- rotate oncall to eng-oncall and open incident doc (/incidents/760500)
- add temporary route fallback to smaller model variant (rwd-3b) for hosted-infer.us-west1
- increase kvcache TTL and disable prefetch for 5m
- investigate auth token rotation origin

maria: created incident doc https://wiki.redwood/incidents/760500 and assigned to @oncall-eric. Starting canary rollback of prefetch and TTL bump.

oncall-eric: taking. running kube exec on gateway to repro tcp connect to ml-proxy and collecting more logs. ping me in thread if you need escalation to infra.

ashok: thanks. I'll take auth logs and correlate with billing token churn (support suspects some customer token automation). sending query to billing team.

support-alice: I'll notify affected customers and offer retries/fallbacks. :white_check_mark:

maria: rolling config now: prefetch disabled on route, kvcache TTL x10 for 10m. monitoring p95/5xx.

sre-bot: Update: SLO alert cleared at 2026-03-17T15:28Z. Please keep monitoring for 30m.

oncall-eric: I've got full tcpdump & gateway logs archived at /tmp/760500.tgz and a stacktrace from ml-proxy. Next step: pair with ml-proxy owner @jane for deeper root cause.

jules: adding postmortem stub, will gather queries and span coverage notes. Closing handoff to infra/auth owners.

support-alice: thanks team. I'll update customers once we have root cause.
